title: R-B ratified: interpretive code constitutional; amendments reasoned
subject: interpretive-code-amendment-procedure
ratio: INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md v1 holds constitutional rank. The amendment procedure is: a build session that needs a constitutional addendum requests it explicitly, reasons it with the operator, and only then delimits the instance that later constructions will reference; the amendment is published as a tier 1 or 2 record naming the IC rules changed and the version jump before any text edit lands. A hand-edit without that record carries no authority.
dicta: Operator wording 2026-08-12: the manual is amended by protocol whenever a constitutional addendum is needed; the session requests the addendum, reasons it with the end user, and then delimits the instance to be referenced for later constructions. The duty-to-use question remains open and belongs to the NLAH mutation path (5A plus human gate), per the memo v1 R-B presentation.
scope_conditions: any edit to INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md; any session requesting a constitutional addendum
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a duty-to-consult the code is imposed via the NLAH path, or if the version anchor scheme changes.
validity_conditions: INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md section 7 records the overruling-grade amendment route; the operator remains the reasoning counterpart
